emulator.name: Azahar
emulator._source: world source: albw/Citra.py connects to 127.0.0.1:45987, Citra's scripting protocol. Azahar is the living Citra fork and the backend London offers.

client.name: A Link Between Worlds Client
client._kind_source: world source: the world registers its own Component("A Link Between Worlds Client") and launches it itself. London starts the emulator with the scripting server on and attaches nothing.

apworld._source: the author's own releases page; the newest asset is albw.apworld (tag v0.3.2)
